annotations.title: Where a provider’s IPs come from

description: ProxyRange’s sourcing check for one residential proxy provider: Clear, Unclear or Concerning, with its confidence, the reasons behind it, and the evidence items (what each source says, a link to it, and when we saw it), plus the provider’s reply if it sent one. Residential proxies route traffic through other people’s devices, so this is what we could establish about how those devices were enrolled.

evidenceLimit.description: At most this many evidence items (default 20, up to 60)

provider.description: Provider id, name or website, e.g. "iproyal", "Bright Data", "decodo.com" or a former name such as "Smartproxy"

name: sourcing_check

attribution.description: How to credit the data when you show it
